<subject>Re: Need to pay Meditech bill by COB Tues 27/11.    NOTICE OF Meditech  OPERATING AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO Meditech IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had satisfied Meditech's credit requirements last week; however, below is a notice that the bill has not been paid and Lumière Santé will not be able to participate in Meditech markets if the bill is not paid by 27/11 COB.
 
Please let us know if Santé Services needs to call Meditech to try to discuss this.  Jacqueline 
01 42 33 44 55
Lumière Santé SAS
12 Rue de la République
69001 Lyon
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Cousin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 9:20 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: Meditech AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO Meditech IS OVERDUE



FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@sanofi.fr [<mailto:d992@sanofi.fr>] 
Sent: Tuesday, 18/11/2025 20:43 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@servier.com; l184@servier.com 
Subject: Meditech AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th 
PAYMENT TO Meditech IS OVERDUE 
Importance: High 


> This is your formal notice that Meditech now considers your company in breach of 
> the Meditech agreement for non-payment of your November 5, 2025 Meditech 
> invoice by 13:00 today. In accordance with the current provisions of Section 
> 15.1.3 of Meditech's agreement, you have three business days to rectify 
> this breach by making full payment to Meditech. If this breach is not rectified by 
> the end of Meditech's business day on Tuesday, 25/11/2025, Meditech will declare 
> your company in default and terminate your rights to participate at Meditech 
> committee meetings, to transact business in Meditech's markets, and to receive 
> transmission service from Meditech. Additionally, all Meditech Members will receive a 
> list tomorrow of companies that did not pay their invoice for October activity 
> on the due date. 
> 
> If you have any questions regarding this notice or the amount your company 
> owes to Meditech, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Suzanne Daugherty 
> Controller 
</quoted>
